scenarios.name: megamorph-turn-face-up-puts-a-counter-and-fires-the-turn-up-trigger
scenarios.why: Turn face up is a special action offered as its own option kind ("turn_face_up"), not an ability activation. The scenario casts the Dragon face down for its megamorph cost, resolves it, selects the turn-face-up option through the activate op, and asserts its effects: the megamorph +1/+1 counter on the Dragon itself (CR 702.168a) and the turn-up trigger's +1/+1 on each other Dragon (CR 708.6).
